market_name: Fort Wayne, IN visitor market (PetTripFinder discovery scope)

geographic_bounds._disclosure: Enclosing box over the approved Fort Wayne visitor market: the City of Fort Wayne, the Allen County lodging clusters that serve it, Fort Wayne International Airport (FWA) on the southwest side, and New Haven on the US-30/IN-930 east corridor. Drawn to contain the lodging concentration PTF-FORT-WAYNE-IN-NEW-MARKET-001 observed in OpenStreetMap (60 elements over an Allen County sweep, 2026-09-06), padded roughly 0.05 degrees beyond it. The box deliberately EXCLUDES the neighbouring Indiana cities a code prefix or a state token would otherwise drag in: Warsaw (41.24 N, -85.85 W -- Marriott issues it the FWA-prefixed code fwafw and it is NOT this market), Huntington, Columbia City, Decatur, Bluffton, Auburn, Angola and Kendallville. Being inside this box is not admission: membership is decided by scripts/pettripfinder/discovery/market_membership.py on the market's own geography.

coordinate_precision_disclosure: All lat/lng values in this file are low-precision (~2-4 decimal places) approximate cluster-centre reference points derived from observed OpenStreetMap lodging positions and general public geographic knowledge. They are seed points for bounded-radius provider queries and cluster labels, never survey-grade coordinates and never evidence of a property's address.
scope_disclosure: 15 cells covering the approved Fort Wayne visitor market, seeded from an observed OpenStreetMap lodging sweep of Allen County rather than from a municipal boundary. Fort Wayne's lodging is strongly clustered and the clusters do not partition cleanly by postal code -- ZIP 46825 alone spans the Washington Center Road cluster and the Dupont Road / I-69 cluster, which are eight kilometres apart and are two different traveller decisions. The market contract therefore declares census_membership_basis MARKET_GEOGRAPHY: this file's bounds and municipalities decide membership, and corridors only classify what is already in. New Haven is included because the lodging there is branded and operated as Fort Wayne east-side product. Does not include Warsaw, Huntington, Columbia City, Decatur, Bluffton, Auburn, Angola or Kendallville.
